title: Our boilerplate
slide_intent: Provide reusable introductory copy so people can describe the same organization consistently. A dated number also needs its date to remain credible when reused.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can maintain a recognizable purpose across publications while prompting writers to check time-sensitive facts.
demonstration: A short usage note on cyan points to three paragraphs of supplied copy. The note calls for the latest statistics, and the example text refers to 2019 figures.
practical_value: Use the supplied description for an organizational introduction and verify the date of any figures before publication.

content_islands.name: Usage guidance
content_islands.spec: Set the title and small usage note at left, emphasizing the instruction about data currency.

content_islands.name: Reusable copy
content_islands.spec: Place the three paragraphs in one larger, aligned block. Point a green hand-drawn arrow toward the copy from the right edge.
